Role Readiness Check

How this tool handles your information

The assessment is designed so you can think through a role without sending your working answers to us.

What stays on your device

Your role context, assessment answers, working notes and task map are stored in your browser so you can return to the check. They are not submitted to Next Generation. Selecting “Start again” clears this information from your browser.

What is submitted

If you request a complimentary Role Decision Brief, the form submits the information shown in that form: your name, work email, organisation, role, decision question, overall readiness position and chosen direction.

Why we use it

Next Generation uses the submitted information to respond to your request, arrange the focused role review and prepare your one-page Role Decision Brief. Submitting the form does not commit you to a recruitment service.

Contact

For questions about this tool or your information, contact enquiries@nextgeneration.ie or call +353 (1) 662 9120.
